newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MMI Holdings offers 76.8 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: MMI Holdings offers 76.8 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Disk drive components maker MMI Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was offering 76.8 million shares at Singapore $0.52 each in its initial public offering.
MMI is seeking a listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore and is offering 61.6 million new shares and 15.2 million vendor shares, a statement said.
The offer represents 34.7 percent of the company's enlarged share capital of 221.6 million shares.
Of the total issue of 76.8 million shares, about 7.7 million will be reserved for staff and business assocaites.
The shares are offered at a forecast price earnings ratio of 11.8 times, based on the financial year ending June 30, 1997.

MMI aims to raise net proceeds of S$30.4 million which will be used to buy a factory in Malaysia and more machinery, repay bank borrowings, fund the purchase of a building in Singapore and for working capital.
For the financial year ended June 30, 1996, MMI made a net profit of S$5.11 million on a turnover of S$90.07 million.
The issue is lead managed by Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia Ltd. The offer closes on April 14 and the shares will start trading on a "when issued" basis on April 16.
